title.narrative: Pakistan Public Resources for Inclusive Development Multiphase Programmatic Approach: Federal

description.narrative: Strengthen the fiscal system to support macroeconomic stability and service delivery.

The proposed MPA will involve a series of Program-for-Results operations at the federal and provincial levels. The MPA will support achievement of CPF Outcome 5 'increasing public resources for inclusive service delivery' and the implementation of the government Uraan Pakistan Economic Transformation plan, including reforms under the National Fiscal Pact. This program, to be implemented at the federal level, is part of the first phase of the MPA. It will contribute to reforms under three results areas: 1) Raising tax revenues (including through reducing tax expenditures, improving tax institutions, and mobilizing new revenue sources) 2) Improving the efficiency and alignment of public expenditures and 3) Strengthening the statistical and data landscape for policymaking (including through institutional strengthening of statistical agencies and improved federal-provincial statistical coordination) The IPF will support the implementing agencies at the federal level - Finance Division - Pakistan Procurement Authority - Controller General Office - Pakistan Bureau of Statistics with IT hardware, software, and technical assistance in support of achieving DLIs. Technical assistance activities would include feasibility studies, assessments, and training. The IPF component in Finance Division will include: i) IT hardware / software to enhance tax and revenue modeling; and ii) the establishment of a technical assistance facility to mobilize consultancy support for policy and technical analysis to achieve program objectives. The IPF component in the Pakistan Procurement Regulatory Agency and Controller General's Office will include IT and software investments required for expansion of FMIS rollout and e-procurement expansion, including servers, terminals, software, and computers. The IPF component in the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics will include i) software and hardware requirements for establishment of a data hub, including servers, software, and computers; and ii) TA and capacity support for all technical upgrading.

comment.narrative: Progress has been made with analysis to inform rightsizing activities, including through World Bank technical assistance. Implementation continues to lag, however, with Cabinet yet to approve recommendations arising from the right-sizing exercise. While some departments have been merged, limited fiscal savings have been realized, with affected civil servants placed in a reallocation pool.

comment.narrative: The World Bank has fielded a technical assistance mission to support TPO with development of the Medium-Term Revenue Strategy. Broader support to the TPO is being provided, including technical assistance support to the establishment of micro-simulation models. Overall progress with operationalization of the TPO is progressing more slowly than expected, however, with key staff positions remaining unfilled to date.
